The entire supplied quantity shall be packed in food-grade pouches of 1 Kg net wei ght each and pouches shall be further packed in corrugated carton boxes containing 20 Kg(20 Nos x 1 Kg pouches) each for ensure freshness, easy handling, storage and protection from moisture and contamination. The carton boxes shall be strong prope rly sealed and capable of protecting the content from damage.

Delivery shall be made at the consignee’s location within the stipulated delivery p eriod and in good condition. 9. Two sample of each offered items shall be submitted by the bidder at consignee’s location prior to the opening of bid. The submitted samples will be evaluated for qual ity, labeling and compliance with the tender specifications. Failure to submit the stip ulated time may render the bid liable for rejection. 10. If the firm fails to honour any part of the purchase obligation, including but not limited to, fail ure to deliver the stores/achieved milestones within the stipulated time for reason not attributable to force majeure, the performance bank guarantee will be forfeitured in full as per discretion of th e competent authority. . 6.
